patterns.reason: Paramount / US Navy marks. Do not ship patches, name tapes, or study art.
patterns.safer: Quarantine the unused jacket study; invent original patches.

patterns.reason: Disney live Class 9 DuckTales registrations. Closest famous entertainment mark to the painted wordmark.
patterns.safer: Redesign the live wordmark away from gold brush + teal 3D + feather underline.

patterns.reason: Gosling Brothers live USPTO mark; they have sued over the name.
patterns.safer: Dark Storm / Storm Highball. Strip Gosling lore.

patterns.reason: Pusser's live marks for the cocktail and bar services.
patterns.safer: Island Soother. Strip Pusser's / Soggy Dollar lore.

patterns.reason: Real operating Havana landmark plus estate-controlled Hemingway name/likeness.
patterns.safer: Invented Havana rum bar. No Hemingway.

patterns.reason: Wavy white sneaker sidestripe is a well-known Vans trademark (also on live Ace).
patterns.safer: Recolor or drop the wave on Ace / hoodie / jacket shoes.

patterns.reason: Campari Group house marks, including APEROL SPRITZ in drinks/hospitality.
patterns.safer: Drink: Spritz / Piazza Spritz. Ingredients: bitter orange aperitivo, red bitter.

patterns.reason: Diageo GUINNESS mark. The shot contains no Guinness.
patterns.safer: Baby Stout / Mini Pint.

patterns.reason: Disney character mark on the kids path.
patterns.safer: Midnight Cooler / Ballroom Fizz.

patterns.reason: Celebrity name; Temple sued over bottled use. A kids game is closer to a product than a bar menu.
patterns.safer: Cherry Fizz.

patterns.reason: Celebrity-named mocktail on the kids path.
patterns.safer: Cola Cherry.

patterns.reason: Ray-Ban Aviator trade dress; jacket study may show a circled-B brandlet.
patterns.safer: Change frame shape; no temple/lens logo.

patterns.reason: Bacardi Madrid IR 1572190 is two feathers + the word TAILS (cl. 32/33).
patterns.safer: Watch merch/mixers. Do not lean harder into feather+TAILS on drinks goods.

patterns.reason: Famous entertainment houses. Any name, character, or logo use is high risk.
patterns.safer: Invent original names and art.

patterns.reason: House spirit/soft-drink marks. Recipe use of a generic category is fine; the brand name as a bottle or title is not.
patterns.safer: Use generic category names (bourbon, vodka, cola).

patterns.reason: IBA classic and Sazerac Company marks for whisky/bars/recipe sites.
patterns.safer: OK as a recipe name; avoid merch that says SAZERAC.

patterns.reason: Cocktail widely understood to ride the Paramount film.
patterns.safer: Word-only recipe name is common; no puppet-hand logo or movie type.

patterns.reason: IBA cocktail name is common; Aviation American Gin is a living brand.
patterns.safer: Fine as a drink title if that bottle is not shown.

patterns.reason: Singapore Sling / Mai Tai / Bellini houses, or a liqueur house mark.
patterns.safer: Keep as generic recipes. Do not claim invention or use house logos.

patterns.reason: House bitters mark. Common as a generic bar term, still a brand.
